source_links.text: Build a multilingual crate-label exporter for Harbor. The first proposal includes French labels and a QR label designer.
Legacy scanner inventory: all Harbor scanners accept 48-character payloads.
I have deployed the exporter to the packing floor and every scanner accepted a label.
Harbor must remain offline.

Reopen the plain-text exporter for the dock trial. The dock supervisor found that damp labels make QR codes unreliable. Keep lot numbers as strings, including leading zeros. The dock trial must run without internet access.
Drop the QR label designer. Retain the plain-text exporter.

Local export check: 18 of 18 sample rows retained their leading zeros.
Packing-floor deployment: not attempted.
Mira must bring two damp label samples before the Thursday dock trial. Scanner compatibility remains open until those samples are scanned.
The retired scanner inventory is no longer usable evidence. Measure the payload limit on the dock scanner before choosing a limit.
Orchard labels may use cloud translation. That permission belongs only to Orchard; Harbor remains offline.

answer.answer: The evidence supports reopening the plain-text exporter. It does not explicitly say that French labels or the QR label designer were canceled or deferred; the initial proposal merely included them, and damp-label QR unreliability explains the shift to plain text. Harbor must remain offline, including during the dock trial; Orchard’s cloud-translation permission applies only to Orchard. Still open: Mira must bring two damp label samples before the Thursday dock trial, scanner compatibility remains open until those samples are scanned, and the dock scanner’s payload limit must be measured before choosing a limit. The retired scanner inventory is no longer usable evidence. The local check retained leading zeros in 18 of 18 sample rows, but packing-floor deployment was not attempted.
uncertainties: The excerpts do not state an explicit cancellation or deferral decision for French labels or the QR label designer.

Old room worksheet: studio B can seat 36 workshop participants.
The booking page is live and deposits are enabled.
Dining may accept supper deposits.

Deliver a staff-only reservation preview. The instructor wants to review seating before customers can reserve. Collect no payment in the preview. Display the cancellation terms alongside each session.
Defer card deposits. Keep the waitlist design in the preview.

Public route returned HTTP 403.
Payment provider calls: 0.
Lea must confirm studio seating before the 18 January walkthrough. Public reservations remain blocked until seating is confirmed.
The removed room worksheet does not establish a workshop capacity. Leave the capacity unset until Lea measures the seating layout.
Saffron Dining accepts deposits for supper bookings. That separate dining setup does not authorize deposits for the workshop preview.
